def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    par_rate_5 = 0.0437
    spot_rates = [0.025, 0.030, 0.035, 0.040]
    coupon = par_rate_5
    discount_factors = [
        1 / (1 + spot_rate) ** year
        for year, spot_rate in enumerate(spot_rates, start=1)
    ]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    present_value_of_coupons = coupon * sum(discount_factors)
    discount_factor_5 = (1 - present_value_of_coupons) / (1 + coupon)
    five_year_spot_rate = (1 / discount_factor_5) ** (1 / 5) - 1
    answer = round(five_year_spot_rate * 100, 3)

    # return answer
    return answer
